text.name: rhm_msg_auto_need_crop
text.text: Opti-Harvest AI: ¡Coseche unos metros para iniciar la autocalibración!

text.name: rhm_help_overview_1
text.text: Realistic Harvesting replaces artificial speed limits with dynamic engine load physics. Live engine strain accounts for header drive, threshing resistance, crop density, and soil friction for root crops. In heavy crop stands, the hydrostatic drive smoothly decelerates the combine to prevent drum choking.

text.name: rhm_help_overview_2
text.text: Heavy, fibrous crops like canola or sunflower demand considerably more engine power per ton than wheat. Harvesting speed will naturally adjust to crop density. Aim for an engine load between 85% and 90% on the HUD for peak performance without grain loss.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_1
text.text: Boarding a harvester activates a compact 4-cell HUD showing engine load, ground speed, crop yield, and productivity in tons per hour. Upgraded machines allow clicking cells to toggle speed to grain loss percentage and yield to live grain moisture.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_2
text.text: You can position the HUD anywhere on screen: right-click in the cab to activate the mouse cursor and drag the panel. In the game settings menu (ESC), customize metric or imperial units and adjust the overload alert sound.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_load
text.text: Cell 1: Engine Load. Green is safe, yellow is optimum (90–105%), red is overload.

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_yield
text.text: Cell 3: Live field yield in tons per hectare (or bushels per acre).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_productivity
text.text: Cell 4: Harvester productivity in processed tons per hour (t/h).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_moisture
text.text: Cell 3 (Click): Grain moisture percentage (Tier 3+ with Precision Farming or Moisture System).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_loss
text.text: Cell 2 (Click): Sieve grain loss percentage (unlocked with Tier 2 sensor package).

text.name: rhm_help_hud_3_speed
text.text: Cell 2: Current forward operating speed in km/h or mph.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_main_text
text.text: Press Right Shift + K in the cab to open the calibration terminal. Different crops require specific drum speeds, fan airflow, and sieve gaps. A poorly tuned combine loses grain and overloads the engine. Tier 2 combines can save custom crop profiles, while Tier 4 harvesters can auto-tune with a single click on the AUTO button.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_rotor_text
text.text: Drum RPM and concave clearance determine threshing quality. Small grains like wheat and barley require high speeds to beat kernels from heads. Fragile crops like corn and soybeans need lower RPM to prevent grain cracking.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_fan_text
text.text: The fan blows away chaff while sieves separate clean grain into the hopper. Light seeds like canola require gentle airflow so they are not blown out the back. Corn needs strong air to lift heavy cob residue.

text.name: rhm_help_calibration_perf_text
text.text: The target load slider sets how hard the automatic transmission pushes the combine (default 88%). A higher value speeds up fieldwork near the limit, while a lower value guarantees zero losses and saves fuel.

text.name: rhm_help_special_1
text.text: Forage harvesters chop standing corn or pickup grass windrows straight into trailers. They have zero crop loss. The calibration terminal lets you adjust chopper drum speed and blower accelerator power.

text.name: rhm_help_special_2
text.text: Potato and beet harvesters draw heavy engine power from underground share drag. Settings control cleaning roller speed and haulm blowers. Cotton pickers and wide-span NEXAT rigs are also fully supported.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_1
text.text: Grain loss begins gently above 80% engine load. Losses remain negligible up to 90%, but climb noticeably past 100%. Running deep into the red zone (>110%) risks clogging the threshing drum completely.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_2
text.text: Harvest losses are fully physical: lost liters are subtracted directly from the combine hopper in real time. Misconfigured sieves or drums can waste up to 25% of your harvest, so watch the HUD and keep settings tuned.

text.name: rhm_help_loss_3
text.text: El desgaste del equipo reduce notablemente la calidad de la cosecha. Las cuchillas desafiladas desgranan las espigas y vainas en pie (hasta un +3% de pérdidas y +15% de resistencia de la TDF). Un rotor de trilla y cribas desgastados pierden grano sin separar (hasta un +3% de pérdidas). El mantenimiento regular en el taller elimina estas pérdidas.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_1
text.text: The hydrostatic transmission dynamically adapts speed to crop density. When entering a pass, the combine holds steady until the drum fills. It brakes gently in dense patches and smoothly speeds up in lighter stands.

text.name: rhm_help_difficulty_2
text.text: Lifting the header on the headland locks your cruising speed into memory. When you lower the header into the next row, the combine accelerates right back to that pace without sluggish crawl.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_1
text.text: Standard factory equipment. Settings are adjusted manually, and loss and moisture sensors are not yet installed.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_2
text.text: Installs loss sensors on the sieves (displayed on HUD) and unlocks saving and loading custom calibration profiles in the terminal.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_3
text.text: Adds live grain moisture monitoring to the HUD and improves hired worker tuning precision to keep losses minimal.

text.name: rhm_help_upgrades_4
text.text: Flagship smart package: unlocks the AUTO button in the calibration terminal to instantly dial in perfect settings and halves moisture penalties.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_1
text.text: The mod tracks crop moisture using Moisture System or Precision Farming mods. Wet straw and damp grain create heavy friction in the drum, increasing engine load and raising sieve losses.

text.name: rhm_help_moisture_2
text.text: Rain and morning dew soak the crop. Harvesting in wet conditions forces the combine to crawl and burns much more fuel. Plan major harvesting runs for warm, dry afternoon hours.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_grain_text
text.text: Full support for game AI workers, Courseplay, and AutoDrive. The server regulates travel speed so helpers cruise without choking. When an AI takes over, it respects your calibrated settings and will never worsen them.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_forage_text
text.text: Wheat and barley prefer high rotor speed (~750 RPM) and strong fan blast. Canola requires gentle air (~650 RPM) to keep light seeds inside. For corn and soybeans, lower rotor RPM (~360) and open sieves wider.

text.name: rhm_help_cropsettings_root_text
text.text: Corn silage needs high drum speed (~1150 RPM), while grass silage runs well at ~800 RPM. On potatoes, keep cleaning rollers moderate (~400 RPM) to protect skins from bruising.

text.name: rhm_msg_req_tier3
text.text: Los perfiles requieren Monitor de Telemetría (Nivel 3)

text.name: rhm_msg_req_tier2
text.text: Los perfiles requieren el Paquete de Sensores (Tier 2 o superior)

text.name: rhm_setting_ai_tuning_long
text.text: Controla cómo los trabajadores IA y Courseplay manejan la calibración. 'Mantener mis ajustes' respeta tus ajustes manuales y perfiles guardados. 'Siempre autoajustar' recalcula según el nivel electrónico. 'Desactivado' prohíbe cambios por ayudantes.

text.name: rhm_setting_enableTutorials_long
text.text: Muestra consejos interactivos durante la cosecha.

text.name: rhm_tut_welcome_msg
text.text: ¡Bienvenido a Realistic Harvesting! La velocidad se regula según carga del motor, densidad del cultivo y cabezal. Abre la terminal con (Shift dcha + K).

text.name: rhm_tut_overload_msg
text.text: ¡El motor está bajo gran esfuerzo! La transmisión hidrostática reduce la velocidad para evitar atascos en el cilindro. Eleva el cabezal o reduce el ancho de trabajo.

text.name: rhm_tut_loss_msg
text.text: ¡Pérdidas de grano críticas detectadas! El rotor o las cribas no están bien ajustados para este cultivo. Abre (Shift dcha + K) para calibrar.

text.name: rhm_tut_moisture_msg
text.text: ¡Cultivo húmedo o lluvia detectada! La paja húmeda aumenta la resistencia interna y sobrecarga el motor. Cosecha en horas secas para mejor rendimiento.

text.name: rhm_tut_headland_msg
text.text: Al levantar el cabezal en la cabecera, la cosechadora recuerda tu velocidad de trabajo para volver a acelerar de manera suave en la siguiente pasada.

text.name: rhm_tut_upgrade_msg
text.text: Las máquinas básicas requieren ajuste manual. Equipa Sensores (Nivel 2), Monitor de Rendimiento (Nivel 3) o IA Opti-Harvest (Nivel 4) en el taller.

text.name: rhm_setting_wear_loss_long
text.text: Simula pérdidas de grano por desgaste de la maquinaria. Cuchillas desafiladas desgranan las plantas (hasta +3% de pérdidas y +15% de resistencia). Cilindro y cribas desgastados tiran grano sin trillar (hasta +3% de pérdidas).
